name: Festejar
description: Ticketing + branded web platform for local clubs / nightclubs / venues in Catalonia — agenda, ticket sales, store, and subscriptions under one always-updated site with unified branding. Founded Mar 2026, Spain.

mentions.evidence: MRR $0 / 0 seat subscriptions (ticketing / txn), ~$38,385 L30, ~$187,515 all-time. Last sync Oct 4, 2026 ~07:46 Warsaw (05:46 UTC).
mentions.indieAngle: Own ticketing + branded event pages for one city/region/scene (student clubs, sports halls, festival bars). Take rate on GMV; language + local payments are the lock-in.

whyItPrints: Geo-niche marketplace txn glue. $0 seat MRR but ~$38k L30 and ~$188k all-time in ~7 months — clubs pay take-rate or event fees to sell tickets without cobbling Shopify + Eventbrite + a brochure site. Narrow geography is the moat.
whyThisMatters:
Clubs in Catalonia get one site for the agenda, the tickets, the shop, and the memberships. Photos and the emails to customers live there too, under the club's own name and look. The pages are meant to stay current, so Google has one address to read.

La Referència del Penedès runs its calendar and ticket sales on it. Village Vilanova puts its parties online in its own branding. The ticket page sits on the club's site, next to the dates, the shop, and the photos. Memberships and the gallery share that same address. People also check Google Maps and the pictures before they come back for another night.

The company started in Spain in March 2026. Clubs pay as the tickets sell.
